segments.name: Technology licensing
segments.evidence: We license our MultiSensing and zForce technology to OEMs and automotive Tier 1 suppliers who embed our technology into products that they develop, manufacture and sell.

changes.text: In 2024, Neonode phased out its touch sensor module (TSM) product business, which is reported as discontinued operations.
changes.evidence: Consequently, we phased out the TSM product business during 2024 through licensing of the TSM technology to strategic partners and in parallel we sold parts of the remaining TSMs.

changes.text: In 2025, Neonode transitioned the zForce platform into maintenance mode and stopped selling it to new customers.
changes.evidence: In September 2025, we made the strategic decision to transition the zForce platform into maintenance mode.
